en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, reads as traditional. 'На чучета' is my reading ('to a pup'), and 'алт'н до два' as 'two gold coins' is also my reading; dialect forms like додоја/посакаја are 3rd person plural past.

words_to_learn.en: hadji (title of one who made the pilgrimage)

lines.cyr: Бог да бие, ај, ај, аџи Зора,
lines.lat: Bog da bie, aj, aj, adži Zora,
lines.en: May God strike, hey hey, Hadji Zora,
Hadji Zora, hey hey, Mitur's wife.
They asked for her at Stefan's,

lines.cyr: у Стефана, ај, ај, за Милета.
lines.lat: u Stefana, aj, aj, za Mileta.
lines.en: at Stefan's, hey hey, for Mile.

lines.cyr: Не ми га дадоја за Милета,
lines.lat: Ne mi ga dadoja za Mileta,
lines.en: They did not give her to Mile,
but they gave her to Iljota,

lines.cyr: за Иљота, ај, ај, на чучета.
lines.lat: za Iljota, aj, aj, na čučeta.
lines.en: to Iljota, hey hey, to a pup (my reading).

lines.cyr: Горни Варош, ај, ај, у Кочовци.
lines.lat: Gorni Varoš, aj, aj, u Kočovci.
lines.en: Gorni Varosh, hey hey, to Kochovci.
Mile put his hand in his belt,

lines.cyr: та извади, ај, ај, алт'н до два.
lines.lat: ta izvadi, aj, aj, alt'n do dva.
lines.en: and took out, hey hey, two gold coins.

lines.cyr: Немој море Миле, што ќе сториш,
lines.lat: Nemoj more Mile, što ḱe storiš,
lines.en: Don't, hey Mile, what will you do,

lines.cyr: ќе расипеш честот на мајка ти,
lines.lat: ḱe rasipeš čestot na majka ti,
lines.en: you will ruin your mother's honor,

lines.cyr: ќе расипеш честот на татко ти.
lines.lat: ḱe rasipeš čestot na tatko ti.
lines.en: you will ruin your father's honor.
